messages.subject: Letter of Claim - Marldale Aggregates / CPE C-900 plant
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Sirs,

We act for Marldale Aggregates Limited. Please find attached our Letter of Claim under the Pre-Action Protocol for Construction and Engineering Disputes in relation to the CPE C-900 plant supplied under the Supply Agreement of 14 June 2024.

We invite your considered response within 28 days.

Yours faithfully

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Litigation
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 5500

Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Letter of Claim - Marldale Aggregates / CPE C-900 plant
messages.plaintextBody:
Mr Gallagher,

We acknowledge your letter, which is firmly rejected. The plant met its specification; the failures your client complains of were caused by oversize and abrasive feed and by your client's own operators overloading the machine. Your client has also wrongfully withheld our final retention of £142,500. We are passing this to our solicitors, Pemberton Rowe.

Gerald Croft
Director, Crayford Plant Engineering Limited
